description:
25 Wesley Road is a double fronted red brick Edwardian property with the benefit of a garage to the side.  Set out over two floors, the property is currently arranged as two residential units, offering excellent flexibility.  Retaining many of the attractive characteristics associated with the Edwardian era, the property presents and exciting opportunity to create a substantial family home subject to the necessary planning requirements, or to maintain its existing configuration as two units.  

The property benefits from a substantial two-storey extension to the rear, providing generous additional accommodation while still retaining a garden area. The garage space to the side further enhances the property and offers excellent potential for a variety of uses, subject to the necessary planning permissions, or alternatively provides valuable off-street parking.

Wesley Road is ideally located just a short walk of Rathgar Village, which offers an excellent selection of shops, cafés, bars and restaurants. The property is also within easy reach of Rathmines Village, while Dublin City Centre is readily accessible from here.

The area is particularly well served by a selection of highly regarded schools, including St Mary’s College, The High School, Alexandra College and Rathgar National School, together with a number of other established primary and secondary schools in the surrounding area.

There are excellent transport links nearby, with Dublin Bus services providing regular access to the city centre and beyond, while the Green Line LUAS is also within easy reach.

Features
Double fronted  Edwardian residence 
Garage / Off street parking
Laid out as two residential units 
Potential to convert to one residential unit subject to planning permission
Quiet cul de sac 
Excellent transportation links
